stays.room_received: One king bed garden terrace room (corner)
stays.summary: An Explorist traveling with a companion booked a standard twin room on points and was proactively offered one of the two corner garden-terrace rooms at check-in. The single king bed was a wrinkle for two travelers sharing, solved with a rollaway. Service was described as extraordinary, with seated check-in, champagne, and a personal property tour from the manager.
